executed_oracle_followup.design: Post hoc mechanism study on 64 new paired starts per task. Reconstructed counterfactual dynamics; no learned controller was trained or selected.

full_utterance_confirmation.scope: Whole utterances with complete publisher transcripts. No utterance alignment teacher was used for selection.

live_control_input: 16 observed ticks and an exogenous goal-directed three-proposal bank per decision
